title: Upgrades
subtitle: Optional step after the control board
text:
With the control board fixed, right click with an upgrade and screw it in. There are two slots and any mix fits.

Each Overclocker adds half the base speed; FE use and intake rise with it. Each Energy Cell adds the base storage again. Two Overclockers run at double speed; two Cells hold triple.

Upgrades stay with the machine and drop back when it is taken apart.
